name: @furlpay/resilience
description: Zero-dependency resilience primitives for financial clients — sliding-window circuit breaker, full-jitter retry, rate limiting, multi-endpoint RPC failover, and resilient SSE. Node 20+ and Edge compatible.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/circuit-breaker.test.js dist/tests/retry.test.js dist/tests/rate-limiter.test.js dist/tests/failover-pool.test.js dist/tests/client.test.js dist/tests/event-stream.test.js
